summary: Completed testing of Dashboard Analytics (Admin vs Employee views) and Password Reset features. All 25 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified with all components working correctly. Found and FIXED one bug in backend: missing authentication check in analytics endpoint.

fixed_during_testing.issue: Missing authentication check - user['role'] accessed when user is None (unauthenticated), causing TypeError
fixed_during_testing.fix: Added 'if not user: raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Not authenticated")' check

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard analytics fully working with role-based views. Admin users (admin/owner/hr) see Revenue, Costs, Margin (red/green), Work Stats, and Top Producers. Employee users see personal stats: earnings, hours, area, avg per job/hour, and median income. Password reset flow is implemented but requires SMTP configuration to send emails. Period selector supports week/month/year filtering.

bug_fixed.description: Missing authentication check in dashboard analytics endpoint
bug_fixed.original_behavior: Accessing user['role'] when user is None caused TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable
bug_fixed.fix: Added authentication check: if not user: raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail='Not authenticated')
bug_fixed.root_cause: get_current_user() returns None for unauthenticated requests, but analytics endpoint didn't check for this before accessing user properties
